decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm Monday to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The use shall not commence until the commence until final details for the control of odours and noise from the kitchen exhaust duct and air conditioning system have been submitted to an approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 5 - The scheme approved under condition 4 shall be fully implemented before the restaurant opens to customers.
description: Installation of shop front incorporating external and internal alterations to existing shop to be used as Chinese Restaurant.
